mapper.select: select id, title, content, release_time, image_addresses from notice order by release_time desc -- asc相反为升序 limit 5 -- 查询数量为5条
select id, title, content, release_time, image_addresses from notice order by release_time desc -- asc相反为升序

select * from notice where 1=1
and ( title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') or content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%') )
and release_time >= #{beginTime} -- 以该天的00:00为准
and release_time < #{endTime} -- 查询包括当天的话，要在需求日期之上再加一天，去掉等于号
order by release_time desc -- asc相反为升序
